items.title: Long-time Bupa customer left $30k out of pocket after shoulder replacement denied
items.description: Australians are increasingly downgrading their health cover, with 360,000 people leaving gold policies since 2020. But some have been left out of pocket for surgeries they thought they were covered for.

items.title: Gary Stevenson's dire warning for Australian property market
items.description: British economist Gary Stevenson is on a speaking tour, warning Australia will follow the path of the UK with "poverty exploding" unless politicians deal with inequality.

items.title: A dead teenager, a TikTok brag track and a parent's dismissal of gang activity
items.description: Ater 'Elia' Good was gunned down early this year with police alleging it was a gang-related killing. His parents say their son was not a gang member but are aware activity is on the rise.

items.title: HungryPanda delivery drivers say police contacted family back home
items.description: Riders embroiled in a dispute over pay and conditions with food delivery company HungryPanda in Sydney say Chinese police have asserted pressure back home to stop them protesting.

items.title: Live: Return of IS-linked families an 'enduring problem' for Australia, O'Neil says
items.description: A Labor frontbencher has doubled down on the government's stance on the return of Australians linked to Islamic State fighters as it faces pressure on how the cohort obtained passports. Follow live.

items.title: Australia 'must allow' IS-linked families to return, UN expert says
items.description: Australian families with links to Islamic State fighters should be returned to Australia to prevent harm and potential radicalisation of innocent children, according to United Nations special rapporteur Ben Saul.

items.title: The engineer trying to stop NASA's Artemis II launch going around the Moon
items.description: After years of delays, NASA's Artemis II mission is aiming to launch next month. But issues with the heat shield are causing some to raise the alarm.

items.title: Live: ASX to rise ahead of wages data, Australian dollar hits 19-month high against British pound
items.description: The Australian dollar has risen to its highest level in a year and a half against the British pound, while the ASX is likely to start its day higher. Follow live.

items.title: Quick hits: Klopp's surprise Olympic job, hockey fight ban labelled a 'joke'
items.description: Football manager Jürgen Klopp makes an appearance at the Milano Cortina Games, while French ice hockey players are unhappy about the ban handed to a teammate for fighting. Here are the quick hits from day 11.

items.title: One Nation circles for frustrated Farrer votes ahead of by-election
items.description: This southern New South Wales town of Gerogery is typically dead on a Monday night, but that all changed when One Nation came to town.

items.title: Fire threat eases but central Victorian blaze still out of control
items.description: Authorities say weather conditions have helped fire crews battling a blaze that threatened homes near Trawool, south of Seymour.

items.title: Retelling the story of a bridge that 'tore a nation of people apart'
items.description: In the 1990s, a group of Indigenous women were accused of fabricating claims of sacred sites to stop the construction of a bridge south of Adelaide. It was a decision that has impacted a community for decades.

items.title: Civil rights leader Jesse Jackson dies aged 84
items.description: The two-time Democratic presidential hopeful remembered for powerful speeches died peacefully surrounded by loved ones, his family said.

items.title: Man who escaped mental health care facility charged with murder over Sydney stabbings
items.description: A 25-year-old man police say stabbed a man to death in Merrylands days after fleeing from health authorities has been charged with murder.

items.title: Melbourne man sets up West Gate Bridge livestream from his driveway
items.description: A man in Melbourne's west has set up a camera from his driveway to broadcast live vision of traffic on the West Gate Bridge, attracting thousands of views within weeks.

items.title: Misconceptions and years before diagnosis. How well do you know OCD?
items.description: Elena wants people with OCD to know they're not alone. But how well do Australians understand the condition?

items.title: Richard Roxburgh stars with real-life friends in 'wickedly funny' stage show
items.description: In the 1994 French play Art, Serge spends 160,000 euros on an all-white painting, horrifying his friend Marc. It might just wreck their decades-long friendship.

items.title: US military says 11 killed in strikes on alleged drug smuggling boats
items.description: The strikes are the latest from the US on boats in the eastern Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea targeting what Donald Trump alleges are drug trafficking operations.

items.title: Former NRL player's mother speaks of 'seeking justice' over son's death
items.description: The mother of Manly player Keith Titmuss, who died of exertional heat stroke following a 2020 Sea Eagles training session, breaks her silence on her family's multi-million-dollar lawsuit against the NRL club.

items.title: Latest search for Gus ends without further clues
items.description: Multiple new locations were scoured in the search for Gus Lamont this week, and despite unrelated charges being laid against his grandmother, SA Police say no further clues have been found.

items.title: Tasmanian salmon companies must now report weekly on fish deaths
items.description: Biosecurity Tasmania has introduced stricter requirements for Tasmania's salmon companies reporting on farmed fish deaths — but whether the public finds out is another matter.

items.title: 'Dirty rain' and constant hand washing: Jan's life with lead contamination
items.description: Jan Twomey bought a house on Hobart's eastern shore just over a year ago, knowing full well it was across from a zinc smelter. But news of high levels of lead detected in dust samples has her concerned.

items.title: Angus Taylor reveals shadow ministry, elevating Hastie, Nampijinpa Price
items.description: The new Liberal leader announces his shadow ministry, elevating prominent right-faction supporters including West Australian MP Andrew Hastie.

items.title: ASIC announces review into 'lead generators' pushing super switching
items.description: ASIC is investigating whether lead generators are complying with their legal obligations when suggesting people switch their retirement savings into less-regulated investment schemes.

items.title: Police find bodies of man and woman in Rockhampton home
items.description: Police are investigating after finding two bodies during a welfare check in Rockhampton.
